In addition to the subjective MOS score, we conducted a more comprehensive evaluation of the trained TTS model using several objective methods. We selected a subset of 100 audio and text chunks, generating audio from these text chunks using our TTS model and two baseline models (VITS and Glow). Additionally, we regenerated the audio from their spectrograms using the vocoder employed by our TTS system. The evaluation metrics included PESQ, MCD, and APTD (Average Predicted Time Difference in seconds).
